facts.fact: CIPESA states that the Nigerian government suspended Twitter for seven months and that the ECOWAS court found the suspension violated freedom of expression, access to information and media freedom; the document gives no date for the suspension, so as_of is the document's published date and the cut itself is an earlier, ended one.

note: Other countries' cases (Mozambique, Zimbabwe, Togo, Guinea, Senegal) and the continental count are not NGA; the Twitter suspension is undated in this document.
